responsibility: Holds the autogenerated manual-URL annotations for the shared Cygwin/MinGW x86 option definitions declared in `gcc/config/i386/cygming.opt`. Rather than defining or implementing target behavior, this metadata file records `UrlSuffix` links for PE/COFF Windows options such as subsystem selection, DLL generation, PE aligned commons, executable-stack policy, and writable relocated rdata, and also notes options whose documentation mapping is skipped because multiple manual locations match, so GCC’s option-generation pipeline can attach stable help references to those shared Windows target switches.
